mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM disputes d WHERE d.work_case_id = s.work_case_id AND d.status NOT IN ('CANCELED', 'REJECTED') ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS normal_count FROM settlements s JOIN work_cases wc ON wc.id = s.work_case_id WHERE wc.employer_id = #{ownerId} AND s.status = 'COMPLETED'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN wc.status = 'COMPLETED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_records ar WHERE ar.work_case_id = wc.id AND ar.worker_id = wc.worker_id AND ar.attendance_type = 'CHECK_IN' AND ar.result = 'SUCCESS' AND ar.attempted_at <= wc.starts_at ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS normal_count FROM work_cases wc WHERE wc.worker_id = #{workerId} AND wc.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'NO_SHOW', 'CHECK_OUT_MISSING')
